feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 September 2026 8:10am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 25 September 2026 at 8:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Eastern Europe, and a deep area of low pressure over Iceland bringing a cold front over the area at first.


##Wind##

Westerly, backing southwesterly, 3 or 4, perhaps touching 5 at first, increasing southwest 4 or 5 this evening, and 5 or 6 in northern parts for a time overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain soon clearing to become mainly fair by midday, only isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 in all waters late Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, mainly later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
